title: The Naturalist and his ‘Beautiful Islands’ Charles Morris Woodford in the Western Pacific
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
summary: This book is a study of Woodford, the man, and what drove his desire to establish a colonial protectorate in the Solomon Islands. In doing so, it also addresses ongoing issues: not so much why the independent state broke down, but how imperfectly it was put together in the first place.
